title: Round 17 territory-frame USGS GNIS source register
scope: Identity-safe verified starter rows for Guam, American Samoa (Tutuila–Manuʻa frame), the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Midway Atoll. The generated city packs must remain synchronized with the verifiedRows arrays in this register.

usgsGeocoder.parameters: term=<official name>&states=<GU|AS|VI>&include=gnis&maxSuggestions=<n>; Midway used term=<official name>&include=gnis&latitudeMin=28.18&longitudeMin=-177.42&latitudeMax=28.23&longitudeMax=-177.30 (expanded only by the frame bbox in the row screen).
usgsGeocoder.use: Fuzzy candidate discovery only. A candidate was accepted only when Name, Type, State (or null State for Midway), County, GnisId, Latitude, and Longitude all matched the intended feature and the stored point fell inside the frame.

gnisDomesticNames.use: Per-ID identity confirmation for Hagåtña FEATURE_ID 1389443: Class=Civil, Primary State=Guam, Primary County=Guam. The same endpoint also showed that FEATURE_ID 1948047 is West Hagåtña Beach, not the capital populated place sometimes associated with that ID in third-party data.

gnisMapServer.use: Spot identity/class checks only in this round: layer 1 returned Hagåtña gaz_featureclass=Civil, layer 5 returned Guam gaz_featureclass=Island and Frigate Point gaz_featureclass=Cape. Stored coordinates remain the Geocoder primary points recorded in the row notes; MapServer multipoint geometry was not silently substituted.

selectionRules: VERIFIED=1 is claimed only for an exact official name, compatible GNIS feature class/type, intended territory and returned county/district, permanent FEATURE_ID, and an official primary point returned by the cited USGS service.

The USGS Geocoder Type is a grouped label. Rows use the corresponding GNIS feature class (Cities & Populated Places→Populated Place, Islands→Island, Bays & Harbors→Bay, Streams & Canals→Stream, Beaches & Capes→Cape for Frigate Point); the row note preserves the returned grouped Type.

A GNIS primary point is never described as a municipal or village boundary, street-address geocode, generic centroid, island polygon, shoreline, harbor boundary, navigation channel, peak-area polygon, or river centerline.
Generalized coastlines, relief gaussians, corridors, and rectangular frames are display context. They are not GNIS geometry, surveyed shorelines, DEM terrain, ferry routes, or navigation data.
If a same-name candidate denotes a different feature, class, island, census/election division, or political division, it is rejected in identityDecisions rather than used to support the intended row.

identityDecisions.decision: Added as Civil, not Populated Place.
identityDecisions.reason: The Geocoder grouped the record under Counties & Political Divisions; GNIS Domestic Names and MapServer layer 1 both identify the same ID as Civil. Hagåtña Census Designated Place 2414024, Hagatna Election District 1927061, and West Hagåtña Beach 1948047 are different records.

identityDecisions.candidate: Mangilao populated place 2414264 vs election district 1927063 and CDP 2414097
identityDecisions.reason: The intended gazetteer row is the populated place, not an election or census division.

identityDecisions.candidate: Santa Rita populated place 1390020 vs Sånta Rita-Sumai election/CDP records
identityDecisions.decision: Used the exact Cities & Populated Places record returned as Santa Rita.
identityDecisions.reason: The election-district and census-designated-place records are separate features with different IDs and points.
That is the primary-county/county field returned for the island record. It is provenance for the record, not a claim that all of Tutuila lies only in the Eastern District.

identityDecisions.decision: Used official returned name Lata Mountain, FEATURE_ID 1388875.
identityDecisions.reason: A query for MOUNT LATA returned no GNIS suggestion; LATA MOUNTAIN returned the exact Summit record.

identityDecisions.decision: Shipped a Tutuila–Manuʻa frame and omitted Swains Island and Rose Atoll.
identityDecisions.reason: A full political-extent rectangle would be mostly ocean and would make the inhabited island groups illegible. The frame title, gazetteer note, docs, and tests disclose the omission. A Swains Island Taulaga result returned during the TAU search was therefore not seeded.

identityDecisions.candidate: Saint Thomas Island / Saint John Island / Saint Croix Island physical-island rows
identityDecisions.reason: Exact Geocoder searches returned only Counties & Political Divisions records (2378250, 2378249, 2378248), not Islands records. Water Island and the Saint Croix Buck Island returned explicit Islands records and were used instead.

identityDecisions.decision: Seeded both, as Populated Place and Bay respectively.
identityDecisions.reason: They are distinct same-name GNIS records with different types and slightly different primary points.
FEATURE_ID 1613754 is the same-name island in Saint Thomas Island county.
FEATURE_ID 1802699 is the separate Counties & Political Divisions record at the same returned point.
Both are U.S. Minor Outlying Islands records, but only 1393009 returns a Midway point; 1390268 lies far outside the frame.

identityDecisions.candidate: Midway Spit Island, Midway Lagoon, Brooks Channel, and Henderson Field gazetteer rows
identityDecisions.reason: Bounded exact GNIS Geocoder queries returned no matching records for those names during the 2026-10-22 check. Brooks Channel and reef/lagoon geometry appear only as generalized context corridors.

knownLimitations: These are starter registers, not complete territorial GNIS extracts: Guam 12 rows, American Samoa 12, U.S. Virgin Islands 12, and Midway 6.
American Samoa omits Swains Island and Rose Atoll. Do not describe the frame as the full political extent of the territory.
Midway records return State=null in the Geocoder. The config state code UM is a frame label; it was not used as a successful Geocoder states filter.
No territory frame bundles a DEM. Relief is a labelled synthetic gaussian field, and the frame is a rectangle rather than a territorial-boundary clipping mask.
Coastlines are generalized multi-polylines drawn for orientation. They are not shoreline surveys and do not supply the GNIS point coordinates.
